observations.title: Skincare ecommerce MVP scaffolded
observations.content:
**What**: Built a full skincare mini ecommerce MVP with Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind v4, React 19.

**Why**: User request — MVP with product listing, detail page, cart with global state.

**Where**:
- lib/types.ts — Product, CartItem, CartAction interfaces
- data/products.ts — 8 mock skincare products + getProductById()
- context/CartContext.tsx — useReducer cart state (ADD_ITEM, REMOVE_ITEM, UPDATE_QUANTITY)
- components/Navbar.tsx — sticky header with cart count badge (Client)
- components/ProductCard.tsx — reusable card, Server component, Link-based navigation
- components/AddToCartButton.tsx — isolated Client component for product detail page
- components/CartItemRow.tsx — cart row with qty controls (Client)
- app/layout.tsx — CartProvider wrapping entire app + Navbar
- app/page.tsx — homepage with hero + category pills + product grid
- app/product/[id]/page.tsx — dynamic route, async params (Next.js 15+ pattern)
- app/cart/page.tsx — full cart page with order summary (Client)
- next.config.ts — picsum.photos remote image domain configured

**Learned**:
- Next.js 15+ params are async: `params: Promise<{ id: string }>`, must await
- RSC boundary: AddToCartButton is a separate 'use client' component to keep product detail page as Server Component
- Tailwind v4 uses `@import "tailwindcss"` in CSS — no tailwind.config.js needed for basic setup
- React 19: no forwardRef needed, ref is a regular prop
- Images: picsum.photos with seed-based URLs for consistent mock images

Explorar el contexto real del proyecto Food Store y evaluar una propuesta de agentes especializados con routing de skills por dominio.

- Definir si el sistema de routing se implementará usando `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` o ambos.

observations.title: SQLModel 0.0.38: no mezclar Field() con sa_column + FK/PK/unique
observations.content:
**What**: Corregí 20+ campos en los 3 modelos SQLModel (catalogo.py, identidad.py, ventas.py) que mezclaban `foreign_key`, `primary_key` o `unique` en `Field()` junto con `sa_column`.

**Why**: SQLModel 0.0.38 lanza RuntimeError si pasás `foreign_key`, `primary_key` o `unique` en `Field()` cuando también hay `sa_column`. En versiones anteriores esto era ignorado silenciosamente.

**Where**: `backend/app/db/models/catalogo.py`, `identidad.py`, `ventas.py`

**Learned**: La regla es: cuando usás `sa_column=Column(...)`, todo lo de SQLAlchemy va adentro del Column. Ejemplos:
- FK: `sa_column=Column(BigInteger(), ForeignKey("tabla.id"), nullable=False)` — sin `foreign_key` en Field
- PK: `sa_column=Column(String(20), primary_key=True)` — sin `primary_key=True` en Field
- Unique: `sa_column=Column(String(64), unique=True)` — sin `unique=True` en Field
- Solo se puede pasar `default`, `default_factory` y campos Pydantic en Field() junto con sa_column.

observations.title: passlib[bcrypt] incompatible con bcrypt >= 4.1 — pinjear bcrypt==4.0.1
observations.content:
**What**: Pinjé `bcrypt==4.0.1` en requirements.txt para forzar downgrade desde bcrypt 5.0.0.

**Why**: `passlib 1.7.4` asume `bcrypt.__about__.__version__` que fue removido en bcrypt 4.1+. Con bcrypt 5.0.0, el hash de passwords falla con `AttributeError` y luego `ValueError: password cannot be longer than 72 bytes`. El seed no podía crear el usuario admin.

**Where**: `backend/requirements.txt`

**Learned**: passlib está sin mantenimiento activo. bcrypt 4.1+ rompe la integración. Siempre pinjear `bcrypt==4.0.1` junto con `passlib[bcrypt]`. Si en el futuro se quiere actualizar, reemplazar passlib por `bcrypt` directo.

**What**: Created all OPSX artifacts (proposal, design, 4 specs, tasks) for the `frontend-shell` change. The shell builds the transversal layer over the scaffolding from `infra-frontend-core`: route guards, layouts, role nav, global error handling, toaster and root error boundary.

**Where**:

observations.title: Fixed PreToolUse:Write hook CWD bug in .claude/settings.json
observations.content:
**What**: Changed the PreToolUse hook command from `python .claude/hooks/inject-skills.py` to `cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .) && python .claude/hooks/inject-skills.py` with `"shell": "bash"`

**Why**: The hook was failing for files inside `frontend/` subdirectories because Claude Code runs hooks with CWD set to the file's parent directory. So writing `frontend/src/pages/RegisterPage.tsx` caused the hook to look for `.claude/hooks/inject-skills.py` at `frontend/src/pages/.claude/hooks/inject-skills.py` (nonexistent).

**Where**: `.claude/settings.json` — `hooks.PreToolUse[0].hooks[0].command`

**Learned**: 
- Claude Code's PreToolUse hook runs with CWD = directory of the file being written/edited
- Cannot use Write or Edit tools to fix settings.json when the hook itself is broken (chicken-and-egg) — must use Python via Bash to modify JSON directly
- The Bash tool wraps commands in `bash -c 'COMMAND'` (single quotes), so any single quote in the command breaks it
- Use `<< PYEOF` (unquoted heredoc) with Python, avoid single quotes in Python source — use double quotes exclusively
- `\$(...)` in unquoted heredoc: bash passes `$(...)` literally to Python's stdin ✓

observations.title: Fixed: datetime timezone mismatch caused 500 on all auth DB operations
observations.content:
**What**: All DB writes failed with "can't subtract offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes" because models used `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` (aware) but PostgreSQL columns are `TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE`.

**Why**: The initial migration (0001) creates timestamp columns without timezone. SQLModel models added during auth change used timezone-aware defaults. asyncpg rejects aware datetimes for non-TZ columns.

**Where**: 
- `app/db/models/identidad.py` — Usuario, RefreshToken created_at/updated_at
- `app/db/models/catalogo.py` — created_at/updated_at
- `app/db/models/ventas.py` — created_at/updated_at  
- `app/core/repository.py` — soft_delete deleted_at
- `app/modules/auth/service.py` — expires_at, now comparison
- `app/modules/refreshtokens/repository.py` — revoked_at

**Fix**: Replace `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` → `datetime.utcnow()` in all DB-bound datetimes. `security.py` is excluded (JWT exp claim needs aware datetime for python-jose).

**Also fixed**: Migration 0002 (add nombre/apellido/family_id) was not applied. Ran `alembic upgrade head`.
